clue.text: Indian thus cooking tongue

indicators.note: cooking suggests ingredients being mixed and worked over, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An Indian, accordingly, is cooking with a tongue, perhaps ox tongue on the menu.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tongue' looks like the dish being cooked, but it means a language.
explanation.definitionFit: A tongue is a language, and this one is a lingua franca of northern India.

clue.text: Stingy type, hard worker, going about like Heep

parts.note: Uriah Heep in Dickens's David Copperfield is forever professing to be humble
a bee is the proverbial busy worker

explanation.surface: A miser, though a diligent worker, acts as obsequiously as Uriah Heep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stingy' suggests mean with money, but here it means having a sting. Uriah Heep is the fawning clerk in Dickens's David Copperfield.
explanation.definitionFit: The humblebee is an old name for the bumblebee, an insect that can sting.

clue.text: Like the traditional family's sort of energy?

definitions.meaning: describing the basic household of two parents and their children
a kind of power produced by atomic fission

explanation.surface: The conventional household runs on its own kind of power.
explanation.definitionFit: A nuclear family is parents and children; nuclear energy comes from splitting atoms.

clue.text: Random producer tells Tom off

indicators.note: off means the letters are disordered, gone wrong

explanation.surface: An erratic manufacturer tells Tom off.
explanation.walkthrough: Tobias Smollett wrote the novel Roderick Random, so he 'produced' Random.
explanation.definitionFit: Smollett was the eighteenth-century Scottish novelist who wrote The Adventures of Roderick Random.

clue.text: Very active, as existing strikers should be?

definitions.meaning: lively, vigorous and full of energy
existing means living, and strikers in football are expected to boot the ball

explanation.surface: Lively, just as working footballers ought to be.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means full of energy; literally, living and booting the ball, fitting for forwards.

clue.text: Prompt that's visible when speaking

indicators.note: when speaking means the phrase for visible is said, not spelt

parts.note: something in sight can be seen

explanation.surface: A cue that can be seen when someone talks.
explanation.definitionFit: To incite is to prompt or urge someone to act.

clue.text: Large cat you reportedly abandoned in the past

indicators.note: abandoned means the named letter is dropped from the big cat's name

parts.note: the ounce is the snow leopard, a large wild cat

indicators.note: reportedly means we want the letter that sounds like the word you

parts.note: said aloud, the word you is the letter U

explanation.surface: Someone says a big cat was deserted long ago.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reportedly' turns 'you' into the letter U, which is removed from OUNCE.
explanation.definitionFit: Formerly, at one time: an adverb meaning at some point before now.

clue.text: Joe bored by first half of game, being chicken

indicators.note: bored by means the playwright's name is pierced by the other piece

parts.note: Joe Orton was the English playwright of Loot and Entertaining Mr Sloane

indicators.note: first half of means only the opening half of the game's name is used

parts.note: ping-pong is table tennis

explanation.surface: Joe gets bored halfway through a match and turns out to be a coward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chicken' looks like coward but is a breed of hen.
explanation.definitionFit: The Orpington is a breed of domestic fowl developed in Kent.

clue.text: Church institute originally opposing alcoholic drink

indicators.note: originally means the first letter of the word institute

parts.note: anti means against, opposing

explanation.surface: A church body originally opposed drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Chianti is a red wine from Tuscany.

clue.text: Dandy pasta tubes

definitions.meaning: a dandy is a man devoted to fashionable clothes, a fop
short hollow tubes of dried pasta

explanation.surface: A fop is fond of tubular pasta.
explanation.definitionFit: An eighteenth-century macaroni was a fashionable fop; it is also the tube-shaped pasta.

clue.text: Language of police officer given limited credit

parts.note: cop is slang for a police officer

indicators.note: limited means the word for credit is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: on tick means on credit, so tick is credit

explanation.surface: A policeman speaks a tongue and is allowed only a small loan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'limited' trims TICK to TIC.
explanation.definitionFit: Coptic is the liturgical language of the Egyptian Christian church, descended from ancient Egyptian.

clue.text: Deposit duke removed from city

indicators.note: removed from means one letter is taken out of the city's name

parts.note: Leeds is a city in Yorkshire, northern England

explanation.surface: A deposit of a duke has been taken away from a city.
explanation.walkthrough: LEEDS is a large city in Yorkshire.
explanation.definitionFit: Lees are the sediment deposited at the bottom of a wine cask or bottle.

clue.text: Officer's invention used by posh person in digs

parts.note: an invention is a made-up story, a falsehood
U means upper-class, posh, in British usage
digs are rented lodgings, so the person living there is a renter

explanation.surface: An officer's fabrication is used by a well-off lodger.
explanation.walkthrough: 'digs' is British slang for rented rooms, so a 'person in digs' is a TENANT.
explanation.definitionFit: A lieutenant is a junior commissioned rank in the army or navy.

clue.text: Singer swallowing second-class sedative

indicators.note: swallowing means the singer's word takes the letter for second-class inside it

parts.note: a baritone is a male singer between tenor and bass
B is the grade below A, second class

explanation.surface: A vocalist downs an inferior sleeping pill.
explanation.definitionFit: Barbitone is a barbiturate drug formerly used as a sedative and sleeping draught.

clue.text: Advocate has part in identifying slanderer

indicators.note: has means the supporter's word holds the piece within it

parts.note: a backer supports or advocates a cause
a bit is a piece or part

explanation.surface: A lawyer plays a role in naming a defamer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Advocate' looks like a lawyer but means a supporter, BACKER.
explanation.definitionFit: A backbiter speaks ill of people behind their backs.

clue.text: Phlegmatic type taken from Inverness to Iceland

indicators.note: taken from means the letters are lifted out of the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A calm person travels from the Scottish Highlands to Iceland.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer runs across invernesS TO ICeland.
explanation.definitionFit: A stoic is a person who endures hardship without showing feeling, unflappable.

clue.text: Self-restrained and at ease about batting

indicators.note: about means the word for at ease goes around the other piece

parts.note: content means satisfied, at ease
in cricket the side batting is in

explanation.surface: Restrained and relaxed while at the crease.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the batting side is said to be IN.
explanation.definitionFit: Continent means exercising self-restraint, especially sexual abstinence.

clue.text: Holding a tablet up, received container of pharmacist

indicators.note: holding means the word for received keeps the other pieces inside it

parts.note: got means received

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the tablet word is read bottom to top

parts.note: a pill is a tablet

explanation.surface: Holding up a tablet, a chemist receives a jar.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'up' means read from bottom to top, giving LLIP; 'Holding' is the container signal. A gallipot is an old apothecary's word, rarely met today.
explanation.definitionFit: A gallipot is a small glazed earthenware pot formerly used by apothecaries for ointments.

clue.text: Record church circle held for a very long time

indicators.note: held means the circle's letter is kept inside the other pieces

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record
the letter O is round like a circle

explanation.surface: A recorded church choir held its note for an age.
explanation.definitionFit: An epoch is a long period of history or geological time, an era.

clue.text: One who philosophised about 11's responsibility

definitions.note: the cross-reference points to the junior officer of 11 across, who commands this unit

parts.note: Plato was the ancient Greek philosopher
on means about, concerning

explanation.surface: A philosopher pondered an officer's duty.
explanation.definitionFit: A platoon is the army subunit commanded by a junior officer of that rank.

clue.text: East European fellow associated with our downfall?

parts.note: for a British newspaper, our country is the UK
rain is a fall of water from above, a downpour
Ian is a man's name, standing for any fellow

explanation.surface: A man from eastern Europe is blamed for our ruin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'downfall' suggests ruin but is a literal fall from the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: A Ukrainian is a native of Ukraine, a country in eastern Europe.

clue.text: A way of smoothing things over on the board?

definitions.text: A way of smoothing things over on the board?

parts.words: A way of smoothing things over on the board?
parts.note: smoothing things over suggests calming a boardroom dispute, but it is pressing clothes flat on a padded board

explanation.surface: A method of making peace among company directors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'board' suggests a boardroom, but it is the household board for pressing clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Pressing creases out of laundry with a hot iron on a padded board.

clue.text: Make intensive effort to produce stock

definitions.meaning: a line of descent, a breed or variety

explanation.surface: Working hard to raise a herd.
explanation.definitionFit: To strain is to exert oneself; a strain is also a breed or stock of animal or plant.

clue.text: Leave stick in basilica, perhaps — one I dropped

indicators.note: in means the stick's word sits inside the rearranged church letters
perhaps says the letters of the church may be arranged otherwise
dropped means one of the two letters I in basilica is left out

parts.note: one of the I's, a single letter I
a bat is a stick used in cricket or baseball

explanation.surface: Someone leaves a walking stick in a great church, one they lost.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leave' looks like a verb but is the noun, time off. 'one I dropped' matters because the church word has two I's and only one goes; 'perhaps' signals the rearrangement and 'in' the insertion.
explanation.definitionFit: A sabbatical is a period of paid leave granted to an academic for study or travel.

clue.text: Desert former pupil captured by American soldier

indicators.note: captured by means the old pupil's letters are held inside the soldier's

parts.note: a GI is a US soldier
OB is old boy, a former pupil of a school

explanation.surface: An old schoolboy is taken prisoner by a GI in the desert.
explanation.walkthrough: OB, old boy, is British school slang for a former pupil.
explanation.definitionFit: The Gobi is a vast desert in Mongolia and northern China.

clue.text: Bassanio's wife left it alone at first

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship

indicators.note: at first means take the opening letter of each of the next two words

explanation.surface: Bassanio's wife abandoned it, isolated from the start.
explanation.walkthrough: Bassanio marries Portia in Shakespeare's The Merchant of Venice.
explanation.definitionFit: In The Merchant of Venice the heiress Portia marries Bassanio and later disguises herself as a lawyer.

clue.text: Uncivil US writer's declaration about abridged works

indicators.note: about means the writer's declaration goes round the shortened works

parts.note: Edgar Allan Poe, the American writer, would announce I'm Poe

indicators.note: abridged means the word for written works is cut short to its first letters

parts.note: literature is a body of written works

explanation.surface: A rude American author pronounces on condensed books.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'declaration' is Poe introducing himself as I'M POE; 'abridged' leaves LIT, a common short form for literature, and 'about' wraps the one round the other.
explanation.definitionFit: Impolite means rude or discourteous, lacking civility in manner.

clue.text: Knot of railway workers by end of track

indicators.note: by means the two pieces sit side by side
end of means the final letter of the word track

parts.note: the NUR was the National Union of Railwaymen, a British trade union

explanation.surface: Rail union men tie a knot at the end of the line.
explanation.walkthrough: The NUR was the British railway workers' union.
explanation.definitionFit: A knur is a knot or hard lump in the wood of a tree trunk.

clue.text: A source of illumination for retiring children

definitions.text: A source of illumination for retiring children

parts.words: A source of illumination for retiring children
parts.note: retiring means going to bed, so this is a small lamp left on while youngsters sleep

explanation.surface: Shy children need some enlightenment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retiring' suggests shy, but means going to bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A small dim lamp kept burning through the night, often in a child's bedroom.
